The elliptical perspective of the wheel is slightly inconsistent. The thickness of the rim varies unnaturally as it rotates, and some spoke connections look slightly misaligned with the hub.
The boundary between the person's arm/hand and the wheel rim is blurry and indistinct, suggesting fusion or poor edge definition.
